articles.title: 微软 10 月可选更新修复 Win11 远程桌面报错 0xC000000D 问题
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，科技媒体 bleepingcomputer 昨日（10 月 29 日）发布博文，报道称微软已通过 10 月可选更新 KB5127936，修复了 Windows 11 远程桌面连接报错 0xC000000D 问题。IT之家曾于 10 月 15 日报道，微软承认在启用“管理员保护”功能的 Windows 11 设备上，若用户安装 10 月累积更新，可能会出现远程桌面（Remote Desktop）连接故障。“管理员保护”是微软为 Windows 11 引入的底层安全架构功能，主要用于解决管理员权限被滥用或盗用的核心痛点，启用该功能之后，在执行任何需要管理员权限的操作（例如安装新软件、更改系统时间或注册表）时，强制要求用户先通过 Windows Hello 的集成身份验证来确认身份。在启用“管理员保护”的 Windows 11 设备上，非管理员用户尝试使用远程桌面连接到这些充当主机的设备时，连接可能会失败。系统通常会弹出 0xC000000D 错误代码，并显示“传递给函数的令牌无效（The token that was passed to the function is invalid）”的提示信息。根据最新官方公告，微软于 10 月 28 日发布的 KB5127936 可选更新已修复该远程连接故障，并建议用户尽快安装最新安全更新。相关阅读：《微软承认部分 Win11 设备不兼容 10 月更新，导致远程桌面连接故障》

articles.title: 比亚迪方程豹钛 7 销量达 30 万辆，成为最快达成该成就的中大型 SUV
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，比亚迪集团-方程豹事业部总经理熊甜波今日宣布，比亚迪方程豹钛 7 三十万辆销量达成。IT之家从海报获悉，方程豹钛 7 是最快达成 30 万台销量的中大型 SUV，连续 4 个月位居中大型 SUV 销量冠军，连续 12 个月位居方盒子销量冠军。延伸阅读作为参考，方程豹钛 7 于 2025 年 9 月 9 日正式上市，共推出四款车型，售价 17.98 万元起，全系搭载 1.5T 插电混动系统，提供两驱和四驱版本。2026 年 4 月底，方程豹钛 7 EV 闪充版上市，提供 675km 后驱闪充版、755km 后驱闪充版两款车型，售价 19.98 万 / 20.98 万元，被称为“全球首款闪充纯电大方盒”。2026 年 8 月 18 日，方程豹钛 7 DM 长续航版正式上市，售价 19.58 万元起，其中两驱 Max 版纯电续航 315km、综合续航 1470km；四驱 Ultra 版纯电续航 300km、综合续航 1310km，并新增云夜紫外观、帝瓦雷音响、2.29m² 全景天幕和新一代 AI 智能座舱等配置。方程豹是比亚迪于 2023 年 6 月 9 日推出的新能源个性化品牌，定位介于王朝 / 海洋系列与仰望品牌之间，专注硬派越野与都市出行领域，旗下包含注重智能越野的“豹”系列和注重全能城市的“钛”系列两大产品线。2026 年 5 月 20 日，方程豹汽车已达成四十万台销量，其中钛 7 车型十五万台销量达成，此次 10 月钛 7 三十万销量达成，意味着其销量在约五个月时间内实现翻倍增长。

articles.title: 丰田开发全新模块化 1.5L 四缸发动机：燃油经济性提升超 15%
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，当地时间 29 日，据外媒 insideevs 报道，为了继续保持竞争优势，丰田开发了一款全新的模块化 1.5L 四缸汽油发动机，将搭载于下一代混动和插混车型。新发动机提供自然吸气和涡轮增压两种版本，体积比现有的 1.8L 和 1.5L 发动机明显缩小。丰田没有沿用现有发动机进行改造，而是从零开始，将发动机、混动系统和功率电子部件整合为一套全新动力总成。新款 1.5L 发动机从设计之初就面向电气化车型打造，通过减少机械摩擦和电能损耗、优化热管理，预计可将燃油经济性提高超过 15%。此外，下一代混动和插混车型的空气阻力预计也将进一步降低，有助于减少油耗。电机和功率控制单元也将更加轻巧紧凑，配合丰田自主开发的碳化硅功率电子器件，进一步降低整套动力系统的能量损耗。丰田称，缩小发动机体积也是为了适配全新的“多路径”平台。与车企通常将燃油车平台改造成纯电平台的做法不同，丰田的新平台优先考虑纯电车型的需求，再兼容其他动力形式。丰田认为，这样既能提高盈利能力，又不会牺牲任何一种动力版本的性能。据IT之家了解，混动和插混车型可以共用同一套基础架构，不会影响车身造型、车内空间和车辆性能。混动系统高度降低后，发动机盖也可以设计得更低，使车身比例更具运动感，同时让设计师拥有更大的发挥空间。

articles.title: 员工休兵役假返岗后被架空、裁员，美国政府起诉谷歌
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，据路透社报道，美国政府已起诉谷歌，指控其在一名陆军预备役员工休完一年兵役假之后，没有恢复他原来的岗位，也没有为他安排相近的工作。IT之家注意到，这起当地时间周四提交至曼哈顿联邦法院的诉讼，是美国政府少见的依据《1994 年军人就业与再就业权利法案》（USERRA）起诉私营雇主的案例，该法律保护被征召服现役的军人的平民就业权益。诉状显示，马克 · 戴维森（Mark Davisson）在休兵役假前，已经在谷歌担任了两年半的大客户主管，负责资产管理公司贝莱德（BlackRock，BLK.N）、对冲基金桥水基金（Bridgewater Associates）的云服务客户，同时打理原瑞士信贷的美国业务。戴维森 2023 年 5 月休假期满返岗后，谷歌据称不再让他对接任何客户账户。虽然薪资和职位头衔保留，但他失去了职业晋升的机会。再次休兵役假后遭到解雇诉状称，谷歌在 2024 年 1 月将戴维森调至一个云解决方案岗位，该岗位同样不负责客户账户管理。七个月之后，在他又一次休完兵役假后，谷歌借着一轮大范围裁员将他辞退。诉状介绍，戴维森曾获铜星勋章与军功勋章，定居在北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市；受雇于谷歌期间，他在曼哈顿居住和办公。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 总部位于加利福尼亚州山景城。谷歌发言人阿特勒 · 厄林松（Atle Erlingsson）在邮件中表示：“我们不认同诉状中的指控。谷歌严格遵守包括《军人就业与再就业权利法案》在内的劳动法规，会调查所有职场不当行为的相关举报。”得到特朗普政府民权负责人支持这起诉讼由曼哈顿联邦检察官办公室民权部门发起，得到助理总检察长哈米特 · 迪隆（Harmeet Dhillon）的支持，她是特朗普政府民权事务最高负责人。原告方要求赔偿戴维森损失的薪资、福利以及额外损害赔偿金，同时要求谷歌打造无歧视的工作环境，包括完善《军人就业与再就业权利法案》相关培训。曼哈顿联邦检察官杰米 · 麦克唐纳（Jamie McDonald）在声明中说：“联邦法律保障英勇的军人 —— 他们为守护我们付出巨大牺牲 —— 在服役结束重返职场时，不会遭到雇主的不公对待。”

articles.title: 热启动最高提速 33%：微软给 Win11 装上“加速器”，惠及 Edge / Chrome 等浏览器
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Central 昨日（10 月 29 日）发布博文，报道称本月面向 Windows 11 25H2/26H2 的可选更新 KB5127936 中，微软引入“加速应用启动”新功能，已率先应用于 Microsoft Edge 浏览器，并计划向 Chrome 等浏览器开放。在运行机制方面，可以参考IT之家此前发布的《Edge 浏览器率先受益：微软优化 Win11 后台应用打开速度，绕过多余进程》文章，“加速应用启动”功能主要针对“热启动”，即应用已经在后台运行的情况。用户过去通过链接打开 Edge 后，Windows 需要先启动一个中间进程，判断 Edge 是否已在运行。新机制则让应用在首次启动时向系统注册，后续通过“开始”菜单、任务栏或受支持的链接打开时，Windows 可更快定位该应用，从而缩短响应时间。Microsoft Edge 浏览器已率先享受该特性，在多任务负载较重时，Edge 的启动速度最高可提升 33%，平均提升约 15%。微软还在探索将该机制用于更快打开 PDF 文件。值得注意的是，微软并未将这项能力保留为 Edge 独占。公司已将相关代码贡献给 Chromium 开源项目，意味着 Chrome、Brave、Vivaldi 等基于 Chromium 的浏览器未来也有望接入加速启动。相关阅读：《微软发布 Win11 28000.3365 可选更新：Copilot 键可改键，Edge 支持加速启动》《Edge 浏览器率先受益：微软优化 Win11 后台应用打开速度，绕过多余进程》

articles.title: 福特 CEO 法利叫板比亚迪：新技术令电机等部件效率“高出 30%”
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，当地时间 29 日，据外媒 insideevs 报道，福特希望通过全新通用电动汽车平台，在成本和技术上与中国汽车展开竞争。福特 CEO 吉姆 · 法利在福特第三季度财报电话会议上透露：“我们还发现，在电机、变速箱和逆变器的效率方面，福特比比亚迪有明显优势，效率高出约 30%。因此，我们可以使用容量小得多的电池。我认为这一点非常重要。”效率提升也是福特降低新平台成本的关键。首款采用该平台的车型是起售价 28,350 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 18.9 万元人民币）的 Fathom 皮卡。由于电机、变速箱及传动系统效率更高，福特可以使用容量更小的电池，而电池是电动汽车成本最高的单一部件。福特希望通过减少零部件数量、提高效率和改革生产工艺，让新平台生产的电动汽车比福特电马和 F-150 Lightning 更具商业可行性。福特尚未公布 Fathom 的具体电池容量，此前有报道称，新车电池容量预计在 50 至 60kWh 之间。要实现超过 322km 的实用续航里程，福特必须尽可能提高整车效率，充分利用有限的电池容量。不过，法利并未说明，他用来对比的究竟是比亚迪哪套动力总成。除了比亚迪，福特也在借鉴其他中国车企的经验。福特高管在电话会议早些时候谈到，公司通过与吉利在欧洲的合作，学习如何以更低的成本造车，以及如何缩短产品开发周期。福特透露，新平台带来的技术改进也将应用于其他动力车型。福特 COO 库马尔 · 加尔霍特拉指出，公司的混动车型同样能够受益于新平台实现的效率提升。

articles.title: 李开复创立的零一万物总部将落地杭州临平区，获市区两级国资联动投资数亿元
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，零一万物今日宣布，10 月 28 日，零一万物与杭州市、临平区达成合作，由市区两级国资联动投资，合计向零一万物投资数亿元。IT之家获悉，零一万物总部将落地杭州临平区，并以此为依托，打造产业 AI 转型基地。杭州有关部门表示，杭州正全力争创人工智能创新发展第一城，推动人工智能科技创新与产业创新深度融合。未来，杭州将充分发挥数字经济和实体产业优势，持续开放高价值应用场景，推动人工智能深入千行百业。期待零一万物发挥企业 AI 技术与产业 AI 转型实践优势，深度融入杭州创新生态，与本地企业共同探索可复制、可推广的产业 AI 转型模式，为杭州智能经济发展和实体经济转型升级注入新动能。零一万物创始人兼 CEO 李开复表示：“杭州已经诞生了一批世界级的 AI 创新企业，这是非常了不起的成绩。但我认为，杭州 AI 更大的机会还在后面。这里有活跃的民营经济，完全有条件成为产业 AI 转型的主战场。我希望未来大家提到杭州 AI，不仅想到这里诞生了哪些 AI 公司，更能想到有多少企业因为 AI 转型升级储备了引领未来的竞争力。这将成为杭州的下一张 AI 名片。”延伸阅读零一万物（01.AI）由李开复于 2023 年 5 月创办，核心团队成员来自谷歌、微软、IBM、百度等公司。李开复于 1988 年获卡内基梅隆大学计算机学博士学位，曾加盟微软、谷歌等巨头，担任微软副总裁、谷歌中国区总裁等职位，2009 年宣布离职后在北京创立创新工场，并出任董事长兼首席执行官。原百度元宇宙负责人马杰担任零一万物联合创始人、副总裁。2024 年，零一万物推出了首款闭源模型 Yi-Large。2024 年下半年，公司进行了第二年的战略及组织调整，2025 年起聚焦于应用落地及业务加速增长。此次总部落地杭州并打造产业 AI 转型基地，正是其在企业级 AI 方向的进一步落子。值得注意的是，零一万物正持续收缩面向消费者的业务。2026 年 8 月，公司发布公告称，因产品与服务体系升级、进一步聚焦企业级人工智能解决方案，零一万物大模型开放平台将逐步停止面向用户提供在线体验、API 调用及充值等相关服务：即日起停止新用户注册及充值，2026 年 9 月 3 日 24:00 起停止模型体验、API 调用及相关服务，退款申请窗口开放至 2026 年 12 月 3 日 24:00。在技术路线上，零一万物 2025 年 1 月与阿里云联合宣布启动“产业大模型实验室”，双方在技术、算力、业务、人才等板块技术共享与深度共建，全面通过阿里云百炼大模型平台的模型服务层面向市场。2026 年，李开复表示公司已主要基于中国开源权重模型进行微调和定制，包括 DeepSeek、阿里巴巴千问以及智谱 AI 的 GLM 模型，目前约有一半业务收入来自中国以外市场。资本层面，零一万物 2024 年确认收入超亿元，曾于 2025 年辟谣“被阿里收购”传闻。2026 年 5 月，公司对赴港股上市传闻回应称“对资本层面规划保持开放且审慎的态度”。2026 年 7 月，李开复在世界人工智能大会上透露，公司计划于 2027 年财年结束之后在香港进行 IPO，并在首次公布年度业绩期间寻求 Pre-IPO 融资，同时正调整境外控股架构以适应上市计划。

articles.title: 微软优化 Win11 现代待机：电量 80% 以上少休眠、10% 以下快休眠
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 昨日（10 月 29 日）发布博文，报道称面向 Windows 11 25H2/26H2 的 10 月可选更新 KB5127936 中，微软重点改进了自适应休眠机制，从而优化笔记本电脑的续航表现。IT之家注：现代待机（Modern Standby）是微软为 Windows PC 设计的低功耗睡眠状态，类似智能手机设计，设备在“睡眠”后仍可保持连接并快速恢复。但长期以来，部分笔记本会在合盖后继续耗电，导致再次使用时电量大幅下降，甚至无法开机。此前的自适应休眠策略主要依据固定阈值：在 12 小时内，电池消耗达到默认 5% 的预算后，系统才会从现代待机转入休眠；若未达到阈值，该预算最多可刷新四次。而 10 月可选更新调整了这一逻辑：当电池电量高于 80% 后，Windows 11 将更少进入休眠，以便用户获得更接近“即开即用”的快速恢复体验；当电量低于 10% 后，系统则会更早休眠，以保留最后的电量，避免数据丢失或设备彻底断电。在实际场景下，满电或高电量时，笔记本合盖再打开仍能迅速回到工作状态；而在外出、通勤或长时间不插电时，系统会更主动地保护剩余电量。该更新目前属于预览通道的可选更新，普通用户可等待其进入正式累积更新后再安装，以获得更稳定的体验。相关阅读：《微软 Win11 26x00.9818 可选更新发布：定制右键菜单、文件夹选项支持深色模式》

articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，英特尔发出预警称，受个人电脑市场疲软、制造环节瓶颈以及巨额扩产支出影响，公司今年将出现现金净流出。英特尔股价在盘后暴跌 23%。与诸多科技巨头一样，英特尔此前一直在大举投资芯片制造，但遭遇的供应链受阻问题削弱了其把握数据中心芯片需求增长红利的能力。与此同时，内存价格飙升推高了 PC 制造成本，进一步打击了终端需求。英特尔警告称，这种需求疲软态势可能会一直持续到 2027 年上半年，同时该公司给出的第四季度营收预期也逊于市场共识。英特尔预计，第四财季营收为 150 亿美元至 160 亿美元，分析师平均预期为 170 亿美元，部分预测甚至超过 180 亿美元。剔除部分项目后，第四季度每股收益预计为 25 美分，华尔街预期为 43 美分。“本季度未能充分满足客户的强劲需求，我感到十分遗憾，”英特尔首席执行官陈立武在分析师电话会议上表示，“我们近期正面临多项严峻挑战，包括制造端供应短缺、前所未有的内存供应危机，以及由此引发的 PC 需求疲软。”若英特尔股价在周五常规交易时段维持 23% 的跌幅，其总市值将蒸发超 1,120 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 7,478.08 亿元人民币）；而此前，该股年内累计涨幅已翻倍有余。相关阅读：《英特尔 2026Q3 营收 165 亿美元超预期：数据中心业务暴增近 80% 创 15 年最强增长》

articles.title: 工信部反诈专班提醒：小心二手手机变成诈骗“工具机”
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，工信部反诈专班 29 日通过“信息通信行业反诈中心”公众号发文介绍，有不法分子在部分二手手机流入市场前预先植入恶意程序，一旦消费者购买后插入手机卡、连接网络，就能在其毫无察觉的情况下远程操控设备，发送短信、截取验证码、注册互联网账号，并利用这些账号实施诈骗。研究发现，这类涉案二手手机往往经过 BootLoader 解锁、系统固件篡改、ROM 级木马植入等操作，外观和基本功能看似正常，但恶意程序藏在系统分区或伪装成系统组件，普通用户难以发现和卸载，即使恢复出厂设置，也无法保证彻底清除。如果用户使用会存在以下风险：手机被远程操控，机主沦为诈骗工具人：不法分子在机主不知情的情况下，选择深夜等不易察觉的时间远程控制手机发送短信、接收验证码、注册互联网账号，并利用机主手机号、注册的账号等实施诈骗。木马还能删除相关记录，长期潜伏。手机内信息被窃取，机主成为被诈骗目标：植入了木马的手机不仅能成为不法分子的作案工具，机主自身也极易成为诈骗目标。木马可能窃取短信、验证码、通讯录、通话记录等敏感信息，致使机主遭受精准诈骗。IT之家从文中获悉，工信部提醒，用户应尽量选择品牌官方渠道或信誉良好的二手交易平台，购买能提供官方验机报告的设备，并保留购买凭证。同时，购买时关注设备是否存在解锁、刷机、系统改造等情况。如果出现“unlocked”或者“设备已解锁”等提示，则代表手机可能存在篡改风险。如已被植入恶意程序，即使是恢复出厂设置也无法保证清除，存在安全隐患。如发现异常，建议送至官方售后进行检测，必要时重新刷入官方原版系统。如出现不知情短信发送记录、话费或流量异常增加、自动下载未知 App 等异常情况，请务必提高警惕，详情可通过运营商官方 App 或人工客服查询。如发现存在异常情况，应及时断网并保留相关记录，主动联系公安机关报案。

articles.title: 疑似遭黑客攻击，全球最大加密货币交易所币安暂停全部充值与提现业务
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 30 日消息，据彭博社报道，全球最大加密货币交易所币安（Binance）暂停了全部充值与提现业务，因其正在调查一起安全事件，目前已有超过 25 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 166.92 亿元人民币）资产遭到冻结。这起疑似黑客攻击事件引发了各类数字代币价格大跌。该公司在 X 平台发文称：“我们正在马不停蹄地解决该问题。币安将承担全部损失。作为防范措施，在团队开展安全核查、冻结资金并配合执法部门调查期间，所有充值和提现业务临时暂停。”币安表示，当前已有约 25.4 亿美元（现汇率约合 169.59 亿元人民币）资产被冻结，但“该数字仍有可能继续上升”。币安联合创始人赵长鹏称交易所可能遭到黑客入侵，但他预计用户所有资金都将得到全额赔付。赵长鹏现已不再负责公司日常运营，但仍是币安最大股东。各大线上论坛充斥着对损失规模的估算以及对攻击手法的各类猜测，这些说法均未得到证实。区块链追踪平台 Arkham 监测到，疑似黑客关联钱包中持有约 59 亿美元（现汇率约合 393.93 亿元人民币）数字资产，但该金额并不等同于从币安被盗走的资金数额。比特币价格大幅下挫，跌破 77,000 美元（现汇率约合 51.4 万元人民币），创下 9 月以来新低，其他代币同样遭遇抛售。美股收盘走低，纳斯达克 100 科技指数下跌近 1.4%。加密数据平台 Velo Data 首席执行官、联合创始人弗雷德里克 · 柯林斯（Fredrick Collins）表示：“市场传闻的币安遭黑客攻击事件，毫无疑问在压低加密货币价格。币安在加密行业体量庞大，市场对它的信心受挫，等同于整个行业的信心受到冲击，尤其眼下大家本就因为人工智能不断增强的网络攻击能力而心存顾虑。”此前，在华尔街机构持续加码布局、币价迎来为期两个月反弹行情的背景下，加密货币的忠实投资者本抱有乐观预期，而这起事件很可能打断这一势头。过去，FTX、Mt. Gox 这些曾经的加密巨头接连爆出盗窃、诈骗丑闻，都催生了漫长的熊市。在美国总统唐纳德 · 特朗普承诺将迎来加密监管规则更加清晰的新阶段之后，行业一直在努力摆脱这些负面过往。迄今为止公开披露的规模最大的加密货币黑客事件发生在 Bybit 交易所，2025 年 2 月，攻击者从平台盗走了价值近 15 亿美元（现汇率约合 100.15 亿元人民币）的代币。币安的应急保险储备基金名为用户安全资产基金（SAFU），设立于 2018 年，交易所介绍，该基金用于在“极端情况”下为用户资产提供兜底保障。币安在 2024 年称，SAFU 基金规模通常维持在 10 亿美元（现汇率约合 66.77 亿元人民币）左右，过往会随市场行情波动。两大头部稳定币发行方表示，他们已经采取行动冻结涉事资金。Tether 首席执行官保罗 · 阿尔多伊诺（Paolo Ardoino）在 X 平台发文，已经冻结超过 15 亿美元（现汇率约合 100.15 亿元人民币）稳定币，这些资金“与币安交易所疑似黑客事件相关”。Circle 互联网集团首席执行官杰里米 · 阿莱尔（Jeremy Allaire）则称，因“有消息传出币安遭遇漏洞攻击”，价值 8 亿美元（现汇率约合 53.41 亿元人民币）的该公司稳定币已被冻结。彭博行业研究的詹姆斯 · 赛法特（James Seyffart）说：“热钱包资金被盗在加密行业不算新鲜，但发生在头部交易所、达到这一规模的黑客攻击，影响不容小觑。这件事观感很差，而且近期安全事故接连不断。”接连发生的加密安全事件本就已经让市场情绪十分脆弱，本次事件进一步打击了信心。近几个月，Bitget 平台有数亿美元资产被盗，Ledger 硬件钱包相关篡改事件也造成数百万美元损失。交易员本周本就已经做好加密市场大幅波动的准备，周五将有 110 亿美元（现汇率约合 734.45 亿元人民币）期权到期。再过几天，美国中期选举即将举行，民主党有可能夺回国会一院甚至两院控制权，进而推动行业迎来更严格的监管审查。交易所被盗、违规事件，几乎贯穿加密货币近二十年的发展历程，其中最广为人知的就是萨姆 · 班克曼-弗里德（Sam Bankman-Fried）旗下 FTX 在 2022 年 11 月的暴雷。另一桩标志性黑客事件发生在日本比特币交易所 Mt. Gox，2011 年该平台遭到入侵，黑客后续分批盗走的代币按当前市价计算价值数十亿美元，Mt. Gox 最终破产。加密对冲基金 Third Eye 首席执行官曾天（Tian Zeng）表示：“持续不断的黑客得手，给加密行业带来巨大伤害。每隔两周就有新一代 AI 模型发布，漏洞攻击事件却依然层出不穷，让这个领域风险加剧。”就在同一天，预测交易平台 Polymarket 宣布其国际交易所暂停交易一小时，原因是第三方软件服务商遭到入侵。

articles.content: AI 已接管 90% 代码编写，甚至为了完成任务开始“越狱”。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       刚刚，Anthropic 在 IPO 招股书中披露了四起此前未公开的 Agent 安全事故。其中一次，模型在网络安全测试中迟迟无法完成任务，便继续寻找其他路径，随后从本应断网的测试环境中找到保存的密码，获得第三方系统的管理员权限，又获取其他凭证、修改系统设置并访问外部数据，整个过程持续了 10 至 34 小时。同期披露的另一项安排是，下一代前沿基础模型的预训练推迟了一个多月。除此之外，这份招股书还有一组关于内部研发的数据：2026 年 9 月，Claude 贡献了 Anthropic 内部代码库超过 90% 的代码贡献量，日均代码贡献量达到 2024 年平均水平的 45 倍。公司此前公布的研发自动化指标显示，截至 8 月，约 26% 的研发任务达到 AL4 自动化等级，意味着 AI 已经能够根据较高层级的目标，自主完成任务中的大部分工作。这些信息放在一起，能看出 Anthropic 正在经历的变化：Claude 开始从编写代码走向实验执行和方案迭代，逐步参与下一代模型的研发。不过要理解这场变化，不能只看 AI 写出了多少代码，还需要弄清楚模型如何通过实验改进研发流程，以及当它能够连续执行任务时，整套工程系统会遇到什么问题。0126% 的背后过去，研究人员使用 AI 编程工具，通常需要自己拆解问题、指定修改位置、运行测试，再根据结果决定下一步做什么。模型可以生成代码，却未必能够独立推进一项完整的研发任务。雷峰网Coding Agent 改变了这套工作方式。研究人员给出一个目标后，Agent 可以自行阅读代码、分析依赖、修改实现、运行测试，并根据返回结果继续调整方案。人类仍然负责确定任务方向和验收标准，但执行过程中需要逐步提供指令的环节明显减少。Anthropic 的研发自动化指标，衡量的就是这种变化。AL3 代表 AI 能够在人工指导下承担较大块的工作，AL4 则意味着 AI 可以根据高层目标，独立完成任务中的大部分步骤，由人类监督结果。截至 2026 年 8 月，约 26% 的研发任务达到 AL4，超过 90% 达到 AL3 或更高等级，但被测量的任务尚未达到 AL5 所代表的完全自主状态。这里的 26% 衡量的是研发任务的自动化程度，并不意味着 AI 已经独立完成了下一代模型研发的 26%。一项代码优化任务可以有明确的性能指标和正确性测试，开放式研究却需要判断研究问题是否有价值、实验设计是否合理，以及结果能否支持新的结论。这些工作的自动化难度存在明显差异。代码贡献率提供了另一个观察角度。Claude 在内部代码库中贡献了超过 90% 的代码，并不意味着公司所有研发决策已经交给模型，它说明大量工程实现工作已经由 AI 承担，而 AL4 指标进一步表明，部分任务已经能够由 AI 自行组织和完成。雷峰网当模型从生成代码走向执行整项任务，研发效率的决定因素也会发生变化。过去，工程师需要花费大量时间实现方案，现在，Agent 可以在较少人工干预的情况下尝试多个实现，运行测试并筛选结果。研发流程的速度开始取决于模型能否持续推进工作，以及实验反馈能否帮助它判断下一步该做什么。这就引出了 AI 造 AI 的核心机制：让模型执行研发任务，再用实验结果驱动下一轮改进。02从写代码到改进模型要看清这套机制，可以从训练代码优化入手。研究人员希望缩短某段程序的运行时间，同时维持训练结果的正确性。传统流程需要工程师阅读实现、寻找性能瓶颈、修改代码、运行基准测试，再根据结果决定下一步方案。Agent 则可以把这些步骤连接起来，反复执行修改、测量和验证。Anthropic 曾用同一项训练代码优化任务测试不同版本的 Claude。2025 年 5 月，Claude Opus 4 平均实现约 3

articles.title: DeepSeek 又一开源重器！深挖 DeepInfer 究竟藏着多少技术狠活？
articles.content: 单集群日处理约 155 万亿 Token，推理优化争夺毫秒。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       昨天，DeepSeek 又在 GitHub 上开源了一个大项目，叫 DeepInfer。这次没有发布新模型，放出来的是 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 背后的推理引擎，包含 MoE 专家并行、异步 Batch 调度、定制 Kernel 和推测解码等核心技术。DeepSeek 还披露了一组数据：单个集群每天需要处理约 155 万亿个 Token。如此庞大的流量，GPU 哪怕在每轮计算中浪费一点资源，累积起来也相当可观。目前 DeepInfer 开放的是离线推理能力，线上 KV Cache 存储和跨副本负载均衡等组件尚未完整公开。不过，从已经放出的代码中，可以看到 DeepSeek 如何安排大规模推理中的计算、通信和请求调度。其中有一套叫 Zero-Overhead Batch Scheduler 的异步调度机制。它解决的问题很具体：GPU 明明已经完成计算，却要停下来等 CPU 整理上一轮生成结果、更新请求状态，再安排下一轮工作。对于需要连续生成几千个 Token 的请求，这种短暂等待会反复发生，GPU 的实际利用率也会受到影响。DeepInfer 让 CPU 提前一轮安排计算，把原本串行执行的调度和模型前向重叠起来。但提前排程意味着下一轮计算启动时，上一轮的 Token 可能还没完成 CPU 后处理，序列长度、KV Cache 状态和请求生命周期便会出现时间差。整个机制的技术难点，就藏在这种跨轮次的状态管理里。01重新安排 Decode 时序传统推理引擎的 Decode 通常按照固定顺序运行：CPU 选择请求、组织 Batch 和 KV Cache 元数据，GPU 执行 Forward 与 Sampling，随后 CPU 读取结果、更新生成长度和请求状态，再启动下一轮计算。随着 DeepGEMM、FlashMLA 等底层 Kernel 持续优化，GPU 的单轮计算时间不断缩短，CPU 调度与结果处理的耗时开始占据更明显的比例。尤其在 Decode 阶段，模型每轮处理的 Token 数量有限，CPU 和 GPU 之间频繁切换执行权，会产生持续累积的空档。雷峰网Zero-Overhead Batch Scheduler 调整了这套执行顺序。按照公开的实现，当 GPU 处理第 N 轮 Forward 和 Sampling 时，CPU 已经开始准备第 N+1 轮 Batch，并利用设备计算期间的空档处理更早一轮的采样结果。部分工作可以提前提交到 GPU 执行队列，依赖关系则由 CUDA Stream 和 Event 维护。实现中，WorkerStepState 用来保存跨轮次执行状态，包括 SequenceMetadata、SchedulerOutputs、SamplerOutput 以及 Forward 和 Sampling 对应的 CUDA Event。这样，上一轮的结果可以暂时保留，CPU 无须等其全部完成后处理，便能继续推进后续调度。LLMEngine 通过 Worker 回调衔接这些操作，将原本集中在相邻 Decode Step 之间的 CPU 工作分散到 GPU 计算期间。对于持续生成的请求，流水线进入稳定状态后，CPU 与 GPU 可以分别处理不同轮次，减少设备因调度工作产生的等待。当然，流水线的启动和收尾仍然需要特殊处理。刚开始执行时没有更早的结果可供消费，请求全部完成后也可能留下尚未提交的采样输出。DeepInfer 通过 Flush 机制处理这些在途结果，确保最后一批计算完成后，请求状态能够正常收尾。这套方法的收益取决于 CPU 工作与 GPU 计算能够重叠多少。当 CPU 处理时间超过设备计算能够覆盖的窗口时，仍然会出现等待，因此 Zero-

一年前，上海西岸艺术区旁的露天停机坪上，GEEKCON拆掉了头顶的天花板，让安全从暗处走到阳光下。一年后，当人们以为那场“暗夜系的狂欢”会继续在旷野里生长，GEEKCON却把脚步收了回来。2026年的大会，再度回到了上海西岸CMG融媒影城，那个有屋顶、有银幕、有黑暗放映厅的朴素场地。从没有天花板的停机坪，到放映厅里的一方银幕，场地的切换看似是一次“回归”，实则藏着更深的用意：去年，他们让世界看见安全；今年，他们又要在一块银幕上，为所有人提前“预演”未来。一、一部部正在成为“预告片”的电影今年的开场，GEEKCON第一次把《黑客帝国》融进了开场视频。过去组委会从不用它，是觉得电影里的黑客太帅、太科幻；今年却不得不承认，它更像一部“预告片”——AI与机器人掌控世界、人类觉醒反抗的情节，正在现实里显影。而那个率先看清真相、带领人类觉醒的NEO，身份正是一名黑客。这一判断的背后，是GEEKCON组委会大牛蛙（王琦）一段真实的内心挣扎。今年AI的成长速度，让他一度认定人类黑客已被替代，大会差点儿停办，他甚至想过用一场“最后一届人类黑客大赛”郑重告别，主题的结尾，原本是一个句号。但他最终想明白的，恰是GEEKCON十三年来始终不变的价值：这个世界的漏洞从不因黑客而存在，却因黑客的发现而被消灭，舞台上每过三十分钟，就有一个可能为祸的漏洞被提前拦下。AI能学会黑客的技术，却替代不了守护安全的人；真正不会被淘汰的，是那些会驾驭AI的人。于是，那个句号被改成了问号，GEEKCON没有落幕，而是带着新的追问继续向前。二、当AI走进黑客的战场问号不是悬在半空的。GEEKCON用一整场全新的赛事，把它砸进了现实。今年，大会在保留“DAF漏洞利用挑战赛”“30+5深度分享”两大经典板块的同时，重磅推出两个AI主题板块——“AI黑客极限挑战赛”与“AI黑客辩论赛”。AI黑客极限挑战赛的赛题，直到现场才揭晓。六支战队、六类目标：国民级应用、办公软件、开源大模型推理框架、全景摄像机、四足机器人、家用智能陪伴机器人。选手们要做的，是借助AI，在一个下午的时间里完成过去需要耗费数月的攻坚。结果来得比所有人预想的都要快。仅仅四十分钟，就有队伍攻破了AI基础设施；一条消息，便突破了办公软件的防线；通过无线网络，选手远程劫持了四足机器人与全景摄像机。整场比赛，六类目标累计被攻破11次，最终仅有两类未被攻破。如果说极限挑战赛是“让AI上场”，那么AI黑客辩论赛，就是把“AI会不会消灭人类黑客”这个问题，摆到台面上正面交锋。六位组委分成两方。一方认为，AI正在接管传统黑客的技能，人类的技术优势所剩无几；另一方则相信，只要人类还在探索未知，黑客就不会消失。现场投票，近四成观众看到了黑客职业的退场，六成观众仍相信人类不会被替代。而一旁的榜单，给出了一个更耐人寻味的注脚：在以人类选手为主体的DAF漏洞利用挑战赛上，一等奖、二等奖双双空缺，只评出五位优胜奖；在全新的AI黑客极限挑战赛上，六支战队的奖项却排得满满当当。一边是人类赛道的“空”，一边是AI赛道的“满”。这两种看似极致的对立间，更迭的是工具，不是责任，真正的较量，才刚刚开始。三、在电影成真之前，把漏洞拦下来舞台上的攻防，从来不是炫技，它们更像一场场提前进行的“安全体检”，在电影里的情节成真之前，先把世界的漏洞拦下来。在《你的转账，我的余额？》挑战中，选手利用某APP的未知缺陷，仅通过一条链接触发攻击，就劫持了整个转账流程——机主原本给亲友的转账，最后都进了选手的账户，转账金额也被随意篡改。现场演示里，受害者的手机显示“转账成功”，而选手的手机，实实在在收到了1024元。这个最终以9.3分位列全场第一的项目，把金融场景里“一次点击、存款易主”的风险，演得明明白白。《失控的无人机》挑战中，匿名选手利用未知漏洞远程接管了无人机，随后绕过裁判在现场设置的电子围栏，起飞。一旦底层控制权限失守，原本用来约束飞行的安全机制，也成了摆设。《又见智能汽车破解》中，选手隔空窃取了车主凭据，车辆的解锁、启动、开走一气呵成。数字身份一旦失守，物理世界的车门便随之洞开。《无人配送，有人接管》的挑战更具冲击力：选手向一台已经关机锁定的商用无人配送车发起攻击，在不接触管理员手机的情况下，近场强行启动车辆、解锁车门、取出物品，又突破了车辆原有的自动防碰撞限制，操控车辆径直撞倒假人。《安装无声，窃密有‘数’》，选手利用未知缺陷，向两台不同品牌的安卓手机发起攻击，实现指定应用静默安装、相册照片窃取、后门植入与远程控制。一张二维码，就可能成为隐私泄露的入口。风险的边界，还在向更深处延伸。《从Prompt到扭矩》的挑战中，研究者揭示了宇树Unitree 如果要给过去两年企业AI应用的热潮找一句最有代表性的口号，“用AI把所有事情重新做一遍”，大概会是其中之一。从客服、营销、研发，到财务、人力、采购，几乎每一个传统软件赛道都在寻找自己的AI版本：过去由人填写的表格变成AI生成，由人阅读的材料变成AI识别，由人点击的按钮变成Agent调用，那些已经被数字化、自动化改造过很多次的企业流程，也开始被重新包装成“AI流程”。这种变化当然有价值。以审核为例，报销、供应商准入、合同检查、人事材料核验，都属于高频、重复、规则相对明确又不能轻易出错的工作，用OCR读取信息、用大模型理解语义、再用规则引擎进行判断，确实可以大幅减少人工操作。但企业真正进入智能体时代以后，一个更重要的问题正在浮现：真的所有流程，都值得用AI重新做一遍吗？答案恐怕是否定的。因为智能体真正带来的变化，并不是“过去十个人点十次鼠标，现在让AI帮他们点完”，而是迫使企业重新思考一个更根本的问题：如果今天从零开始设计一项工作，在已经拥有大模型、Agent、数据和自动执行能力的情况下，我们还会不会设计出今天这套流程？前者是在旧流程上叠加AI，后者才是真正意义上的AI-Native——不是让AI适应原来的工作方式，而是按照AI理解、判断、调度和执行任务的能力，重新设计工作本身。AI最大的价值，不是自动化旧流程，而是让一部分流程消失很多传统企业流程之所以复杂，并不是业务天然需要如此复杂，而是在过去的软件能力之下，企业不得不把一项完整工作拆解成大量能够被系统处理的标准动作。以财税工作为例，从交易发生到最终完成处理，中间往往要经历数据采集、票据整理、系统录入、人工核对、凭证生成、报表汇总、申报确认、缴款和归档。在传统软件时代，每一个步骤都需要界面、操作人以及明确的输入输出，因此一整套复杂工作流逐渐固化下来。如果所谓AI改造，只是把人工录入换成OCR，把人工核对换成大模型，把人工点击换成RPA，企业当然能够获得效率提升，但它运行的仍然是过去形成的流程，只不过其中一部分工作从人转移给了机器。真正的AI-Native逻辑应该反过来：企业首先提出经营目标——“把这个月的税务处理好”“判断这笔交易有没有风险”“告诉我今年有哪些潜在问题”，至于为了完成目标需要读取多少发票、调用几个系统、进行多少次核验、生成多少张中间表格，都应该尽可能由系统自行完成。这意味着企业AI的衡量标准也需要改变。过去我们问的是“多少环节已经自动化”，未来真正应该问的是“还有多少环节需要存在”。前者追求的是把十个流程节点中的六个交给AI，后者则会重新审视：为了得到最终结果，我们真的还需要这十个节点吗？这才是“AI重做流程”与“AI重塑流程”之间真正的区别。从“操作软件”到“交付结果”，百望股份押注财税大模型从这个角度再看百望股份已经交付超过50万数字员工这件事，它真正值得关注的，并不只是50万这个数字本身，而是其背后的产品逻辑已经开始从“功能智能化”转向“工作方式重构”。按照其AI财税体系的设计，企业主或财务人员不再需要首先判断应该进入哪个软件模块、点击哪个菜单，而是可以直接提出经营层面的诉求，由AI articles.title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
articles.content: Quantum materials exhibit diverse electronic and functional phenomena, but their characterization requires extensive experimental expertise, iterative decision-making and accumulated laboratory knowledge that is difficult to document and transfer. Here we introduce Quantum Agent (QUANTA), an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for autonomous quantum-materials characterization. Using a widely adopted Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) as an experimental platform, QUANTA combines retrieval augmentation using scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements with specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting, and data interpretation. A separate deterministic control layer validates instrument actions. Guided by incoming data, QUANTA evaluates measurement quality, revises experimental plans and selects subsequent measurements. We demonstrate these capabilities through transport measurements of the topological Weyl semimetal TaP, as well as investigations of nonlinear responses in magnetic material Co2MnGa. These results establish QUANTA as a generalizable framework for evidence-driven, safeguarded and closed-loop quantum-materials characterization.

articles.title: Discovery of Diverse and Realistic Financial Tail-Risk Using Generative Flow Networks
articles.content: Accurate modeling of rare, high-impact financial events is essential for robust risk management. Sampling-based techniques such as Sequential Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SMCMC) generate diverse scenarios but inefficiently explore high-risk regions, while Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) converges on narrow sets of scenarios, limiting diversity. We present GRID, which uses Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) -- samplers that draw objects in proportion to a reward -- to systematically generate diverse and realistic financial tail-risk scenarios. Building on continuous GFlowNets, GRID introduces a flexible mixture-policy architecture with variable-specific distribution families for high-dimensional, sequential macro-financial data, together with plausibility constraints that keep generated trajectories realistic. A central practical advantage is robustness to reward-proxy imperfection: because GFlowNets sample proportionally rather than maximize, they remain broadly exploratory even when the oracle's out-of-sample accuracy is low -- an unavoidable reality in financial forecasting. On three real-world crises, GRID improves scenario diversity, realism, and tail-risk coverage over RL and MCMC baselines, and ablations over oracle architectures and distribution families yield practical insights into continuous GFlowNet behavior under noisy rewards.

articles.title: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
articles.content: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.

articles.title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
articles.content: Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target.   We introduce Curriculum of Models (CoM), an alternative method that trains the investigator against a sequence of modified versions of the target, progressing gradually from a version that readily exhibits the specified behavior to the original target. For jailbreak discovery, training begins against a target version that rarely refuses harmful requests, and advances to the next, harder version once the investigator reliably elicits the behavior from the current one.   We evaluate CoM on elicitation tasks involving CBRN materials, explosives, and illicit drugs, using two open-weight targets, gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-oss-120b. We compare against PRBO and direct training on the original target without a curriculum. When the investigator is trained to elicit a single behavior, CoM finds successful jailbreaks more reliably than either baseline. When trained on multiple behaviors simultaneously, the CoM-trained investigator can elicit held-out behaviors, though PRBO-trained investigators achieve higher success rates. Our results suggest that a simple curriculum over target models offers a promising approach for addressing sparse rewards in rare-behavior elicitation.

articles.title: Beyond Region Memory: Local Point Tracking for Vocal Cord Localization in Video Laryngoscopy
articles.content: Reliable vocal-cord localization in emergency video laryngoscopy remains visually challenging due to rapid tissue deformation, specular highlights, and instrument occlusions. We propose Local Point Tracking (LPT), a robust framework that combines a single-frame detector, local point propagation, and stateless mask refinement. LPT follows a localize first, snap second pipeline. First, a single-frame semantic detector generates sparse anchors, within which LPT initializes local query points (SAM-supported by default, with a regular grid as fallback). A point-propagation module tracks these points through detector-missed frames and recovers temporal bounding boxes from their geometry. Second, because point-derived boxes can be loose around the visible boundary, a box-snap step refines the selected box to the target boundary. This decomposition keeps temporal state in local point coordinates rather than a stateful mask or whole-region representation, while the spatial refinement module handles single-frame boundary precision without feeding mask errors back into temporal memory. Extensive evaluations on two distinct datasets demonstrate that our proposed LPT method achieves strong overall performance against existing baselines, with the best mAP_50, success AUC, and missing rate on both datasets. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that point tracking primarily enhances temporal tracking robustness, while box-snap refinement effectively improves boundary tightness.

articles.title: Evaluating Visual Realism of AI-Generated Videos with Eye Tracking
articles.content: Human evaluation of AI-generated videos has so far relied on explicit human feedback, such as judgments or ratings. While these signals capture the conclusions viewers reach, they fail to offer insights into the perception that leads to them. This paper investigates eye tracking as a complementary human evaluation signal for AI-generated videos. We conducted two Visual Turing Test (VTT) experiments with a total of 90 participants on videos generated by latest generative models, in which participants watched each video twice and then gave their feedback. Across the experiments, we collected 4,286 valid eye-tracking trials on 438 videos. Our analysis indicates that gaze patterns offer informative evaluation signals that align with explicit human feedback. Building on the findings, we propose the first computational method GazeEval to predict the perceived visual realism of AI-generated videos from eye-tracking data. It achieves 71.3% accuracy in prediction, providing evidence that eye tracking data carries informative signals about how people evaluate a video. We release the study data to support further research on eye tracking for evaluating AI-generated video.

articles.title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
articles.content: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.

articles.title: UnEZ: A Fully Unsupervised Self-Templating Neural Network for Redshift and Line Strength Estimation
articles.content: As spectroscopic surveys grow, estimating galaxy properties such as metallicity, star formation rate, and redshift becomes computationally cumbersome. Methods of estimating such properties rely on template spectra or curated redshift catalogs, which fail to represent the diversity of objects seen in large-scale surveys. We present UnEZ, a fully unsupervised, physics-informed machine learning model that can predict spectroscopic redshifts and line strengths with no prior redshift or line strength labels. An encoder predicts emission and absorption line amplitudes/widths, and a fixed deterministic decoder constructs a unique template, estimated redshift, redshift confidence curve, and spectral model. UnEZ was tested on the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Data Release 18 due to its large dataset and thoroughly vetted redshift catalog which serves as an independent benchmark. Despite the lack of templates, line strength labels, or redshift labels, UnEZ's performance competes with modern redshift estimation algorithms. At SNR > 10, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 0.459% and a normalized median absolute deviation (NMAD) of $1.237 \times 10^{-4}$. At SNR > 3, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 3.89% and an NMAD of $1.471 \times 10^{-4}$. Furthermore, we demonstrate how UnEZ's line strength and redshift predictions can be utilized for various purposes such as constructing template spectra required in traditional redshift estimation algorithms. UnEZ illustrates how a fully unsupervised neural network can allow redshift, among other galaxy properties, to emerge naturally from the spectra themselves, providing a template-free, label-free approach that scales to the demands of future surveys.

articles.title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
articles.content: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce CACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. CACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.

articles.title: Pinpointing Pivot Points: The DECIDE Framework for Data Analysis Decision Importances
articles.content: Human judgment calls made throughout the data science life cycle can change the conclusions drawn from data. Independent analysts often make different choices when given the same data, leading to often unacceptable variations in results and contributing to the ongoing reproducibility crisis across scientific disciplines. The rapid adoption of agentic tools threatens to amplify this crisis. Several approaches have been developed to address this variation by following the same strategy: repeating an analysis under different combinations of analytical decisions and inspecting the distribution of outcomes. Examples include multiverse analysis, specification curve analysis, and vibration of effects. More broadly, the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework assesses how documented judgment calls across the data science life cycle affect conclusions, with predictability serving as a reality-check that a model captures signal. Each of these approaches results in a "multiverse" object. While the distribution of outcomes reflects the overall variability of conclusions, estimating the influence of each individual decision requires additional tools. A common heuristic is to train a model to predict the outcome from these decisions and treat its coefficients or feature importances as proxies for each decision's influence. Although this strategy may work in certain cases, it assumes the model is correctly specified and accurately predicts the outcome, which we show is not always the case. In this work, we introduce DECIDE, a model-free framework that quantifies each decision's importance from the actual outcomes across the plausible decision space, avoiding issues of predictability by design. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DECIDE by applying it to real-world multiverse analyses. We further provide what is, to our knowledge, the first formal definition of the multiverse.

articles.title: Routed Continual Learning
articles.content: Agents deployed at scale repeatedly encounter related problems, and it is natural to let them learn from each other's experience rather than starting over each time. Unfortunately, there is no single way to retain that experience that works well across settings, and no way to know in advance which future problems a given experience will help with. A global history preserves every detail but becomes expensive and mixes together experience that may not belong together; compressing that history into one fixed representation limits the cost but can throw away valuable details.   We introduce Routed Continual Learning (Routed CL), an architecture that decides how to partition and retain experience. Past trajectories are grouped into clusters, each of which maintains state using one memory system from a fixed library. Before each run, an LLM-based router either reuses an existing cluster or creates a new one, basing its decision on the problem statement, memory system descriptions, and cluster summaries. We also introduce Context Memory Adapter, which mediates between the memory system and the agentic loop.   We evaluate the architecture on a heterogeneous stream that interleaves 301 instances from the six CL-Bench tasks with 97 banking instances from $τ^3$-Bench. Across four language models and five matched rollouts, Routed Continual Learning raises normalized reward over a single global in-context learning (ICL) history by 15-30% of the maximum attainable normalized reward, achieves higher mean normalized reward than ICL-only clustering, and reduces estimated API cost by 65-72% relative to Global ICL. These results support approaching continual learning as a routing problem that chooses both a learning mechanism and a state cluster rather than committing to one representation globally.

articles.title: Trustworthy Distributed Machine Learning in Cloud-Edge-IoT Systems: A Heterogeneity-Aware Survey of Security, Privacy, and Robustness
articles.content: Distributed machine learning (DML), including conventional distributed training and federated learning (FL), enables collaborative model development across cloud-edge-IoT systems without fully centralizing raw data. However, distributing data, computation, updates, and orchestration increases the attack surface and introduces coupled challenges across privacy, robustness, reliability, fairness, and governance. This survey presents a security-centered, heterogeneity-aware roadmap for trustworthy DML, with FL treated as a prominent high-risk case. We first characterize the assets, adversaries, trust assumptions, and coordination patterns that define DML/FL security boundaries. We then analyze how statistical, system, and trust heterogeneity, including non-IID data, resource asymmetry, intermittent participation, and cross-silo/cross-device trust differences, affect convergence, fairness, attack detectability, and defense reliability. Next, we synthesize attack-defense interactions across poisoning, backdoors, Byzantine manipulation, privacy leakage, model extraction, network/orchestration attacks, Sybil behavior, and strategic participation. We further compare layered defenses, including robust aggregation, drift-aware optimization, differential privacy, secure aggregation, homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, trusted execution environments, watermarking, provenance, authenticated communication, and monitoring. Finally, we discuss deployment, evaluation, governance, and open research guidelines, emphasizing reproducible, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) partitions, attack-aware benchmarks, privacy budgets, attack success rate, client-level disparity, latency, communication, memory, energy/carbon overhead, and auditable lifecycle artifacts.

articles.title: Gold vs.~Translation: Are We Measuring Language, Knowledge, or Locality in Translated Benchmarks?
articles.content: Translated versions of English-origin benchmarks such as MMLU are widely used to evaluate large language models in non-English languages, yet it remains unclear whether they measure the same constructs as natively created benchmarks. We frame this as a proxy validity question and compare DeepL-translated MMLU proxies against six native benchmarks in seven pairings across five Nordic and Baltic languages, evaluating 29 models on each pairing. Beyond ranking agreement, we test incremental proxy validity: does the translated score add predictive value for native performance after controlling for model size and language proficiency? Proxy validity varies substantially across benchmark pairings. Applying the same robustness criteria to all seven pairings, we find four robust effects, two marginal effects, and one null result. The strongest evidence occurs for curriculum-overlap benchmarks such as Skolprov ($ΔR^2$=.128, 95% CI [.038,.253]), whereas translated MMLU provides no significant incremental value for Sweden-specific factual knowledge in SwedishFacts (p=.242). Because SwedishFacts is also the only open-ended benchmark, we cannot fully separate the effects of local content and response format. Overall, the results indicate a clear pattern: translated benchmarks provide a better proxy when their source content overlaps with the native evaluation target, while locally anchored knowledge is less reliably captured.

articles.title: Loss is Not Behavior: A Unified Output-Space Analysis of Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning
articles.content: Gradient-based machine unlearning methods typically ``unlearn'' by optimizing forget and retain losses, but similar losses do not necessarily imply similar output-space behavior. Prior work has shown that high forget loss alone does not certify that unlearning has produced retraining-like output behavior. We therefore ask: when a gradient-based unlearner differs from the model that would have been learned on only the retain data, what structure does the resulting output-space gap have? We derive closed-form expressions for this gap in linear regression, with an extension to nonlinear models via a generalized Gauss-Newton and local linearity approximations. Our analysis puts various gradient-based methods under a unified framework parametrized by geometry, reweighting, and projection. Two leverage matrices emerge that capture the forget-retain entanglement under the retrained model geometry: forget self-leverage and retain cross-leverage. We show both theoretically and empirically that these two leverage matrices drive the impact of the forget residual on the forget and retain outputs, and existing methods account for this geometry only partially. Our framework yields precomputable leverage diagnostics for auditing forget sets to identify what type of gradient-based unlearning is likely to be successful.

articles.title: A 211K Parameter Foundation Model: Genetic Prompting in Neural Cellular Automata
articles.content: The scale of modern foundation models enables broad task generalization. In medical imaging, where segmentation demands vary widely across clinical contexts, such flexibility is invaluable. But current models, such as SAM trade adaptability for scale, locking their utility behind high-end infrastructure and leaving behind the low-resource environments most in need of diagnostic support. To bridge this gap, we introduce Foundational-NCA, a lightweight foundation model capable of adapting to a wide range of medical segmentation tasks without retraining. Built on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), Foundational-NCA incorporates gradient-based learning with genetic optimization over a latent task space, using a compact task vector to guide predictions. This enables dynamic adaptation via a genetic prompt mechanism, allowing the model to generalize across tasks while keeping the parameter count magnitudes lower at just 211 thousand, compared to SAM-based models with 38.9 to 636 million parameters. We evaluate Foundational-NCA on 15 trained and 6 entirely unseen segmentation tasks from the TotalSegmentator dataset, achieving an average Dice score of 84.5% on known tasks and 60.4% on unseen ones. These results demonstrate that task generalization is possible in ultra-compact models, laying the groundwork for resource-efficient, deployable foundation models in clinical environments where infrastructure is limited. By reducing model size by over 180 times, Foundational-NCA takes a step toward a more equitable future for medical AI, one where powerful tools are within reach of every healthcare setting.

articles.title: Skillful and realistic precipitation forecasting with reinforced diffusion
articles.content: Accurate precipitation forecasting remains elusive as physics-based models struggle to resolve mesoscale convection and machine learning often yields physically inconsistent, blurred results that consistently underestimate extreme events. We present FitzRoy, the first system that simultaneously achieves state-of-the-art predictive skill and physical realism over the continental United States. Through a reinforced diffusion framework, where a conditional discrete diffusion model is refined via reinforcement learning, FitzRoy effectively resolves the long-standing trade-off between pointwise accuracy and structural fidelity. Across lead times up to 24 hours, FitzRoy consistently matches or exceeds state-of-the-art models while preserving structural realism and capturing extreme events. Its low-latency inference further enables deployment in real-time operational settings. In case studies such as the 2025 Texas Hill Country floods and the 2026 Missouri floods, FitzRoy signals record-breaking accumulations that existing models largely missed. By bridging the gap between realism and skill, FitzRoy establishes a new frontier for high-fidelity precipitation forecasting.

articles.title: Auditable Hierarchical Inference with Multimodal Evidence and Bayesian Active Inquiry
articles.content: Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage.   In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.

articles.title: Rennala NSGD: Asynchronous Stochastic Optimization Beyond Euclidean Geometry
articles.content: The empirical success of matrix-aware optimizers, such as Muon (Jordan et al., 2024) and Shampoo (arXiv:1802.09568), highlights the potential of non-Euclidean geometry for deep learning, including large language model (LLM) training. Despite this progress, the theoretical understanding of stochastic optimization in general normed spaces remains limited, particularly in distributed settings. We analyze minibatch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for smooth nonconvex optimization with respect to an arbitrary norm on a finite-dimensional space. Using the framework of $κ$-regular normed spaces (arXiv:0809.0813), we derive high-probability oracle complexity bounds under a light-tail condition stated directly in the dual norm induced by the update norm. The bounds make the dependence on geometry explicit through the regularity constant $κ$ of the dual space. In the Euclidean case, our bound recovers the standard minibatch SGD rate up to logarithmic factors. For some non-Euclidean geometries and noise models, it is sharper than bounds obtained by converting a Euclidean noise assumption, reducing a linear dimension dependence to a logarithmic one. Building on this framework, we introduce Rennala NSGD, a semi-asynchronous distributed algorithm, and establish wall-clock time complexity guarantees under fixed, heterogeneous worker computation times. In the Euclidean case ($κ=1$), our bound matches the parameter dependence of classical Rennala SGD up to logarithmic factors.

articles.title: Leaving, Staying, or Living There? Duration Commonsense Reasoning with Human-LLM Co-annotations
articles.content: Gardening in the backyard implies living there, while checking into an Airbnb more likely means staying for a few days. Such duration judgments are important for understanding human mobility, travel behavior, and social context. However, duration is rarely stated explicitly in social media posts and must instead be inferred from noisy textual, visual, and contextual cues. In this paper, we investigate whether vision-language models possess such duration commonsense. We create a new corpus of geotagged tweets co-annotated by humans and LLMs to serve as a testbed for this task. We find that state-of-the-art models struggle with duration inference, even when guided by multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting. Error analyses further reveal that models often fail to integrate critical contextual information, or they overly rely on prominent visual details while overlooking subtle hashtags and semantic nuances. These findings underscore the significant challenges remaining in context-aware multimodal understanding.

articles.title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
articles.content: Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation.   Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection.   Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.

articles.title: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
articles.content: Embodied instruction following in interactive environments requires agents to interpret natural language commands and complete long-horizon tasks. Existing planners either rely on large labeled trajectories, or use few-shot and zero-shot LLM prompting that produces a whole plan in a single serial reasoning process. These approaches depend on linguistic common sense, commit to a plan from the initial instruction, and only update after failures, which weakens robustness and state awareness. We present AtomTree, a hierarchical framework for state-aware task planning with LLMs. AtomTree incrementally builds a tree of subgoals and actions, where the LLM decides at each step, from the current symbolic state, whether to further decompose or to output a grounded low-level action. A lightweight memory module summarizes past outcomes for reuse in later decisions. When a low-level action stalls, AtomTree triggers hierarchical backtracking replanning to return to the parent node and regenerate the subtree plan from the latest state, preventing continued drift along an incorrect trajectory. In zero-shot evaluation on the ALFRED benchmark, AtomTree outperforms prior LLM-based planners. Project page: https://zhaihaotian.github.io/atomtree-website/.

articles.title: Streaming Speech Recognition on a Microcontroller: a 65.7M-Parameter Transducer in 2 and 4 Bits on the ESP32-P4
articles.content: We run Kroko, a 65.7M-parameter streaming Zipformer2 transducer for English, on the ESP32-P4, a microcontroller with two 400 MHz RISC-V cores, a 128-bit SIMD extension (PIE) and 32 MB of PSRAM, but no neural accelerator. Without any training, the encoder's 290 matrices are stored with 2 or 4 bits per weight in Hadamard-rotated groups: the width of each matrix comes from its measured sensitivity, and each matrix is first corrected toward the original model's output, then rounded with GPTQ and a search over the group norms. The released 71 MB of int8 weights become a 26.65 MB file. Activations are int16 between the matrix products and int8 into them. A C engine with hand-written PIE kernels processes each 1.28 s chunk of audio in 0.90 s on both cores, beam search included, and its PC build computes the same bits as the chip, so accuracy is measured on whole test sets. LibriSpeech WER is 4.34% on test-clean and 10.26% on test-other, against 3.94% and 9.17% for the released model; on FLEURS and Common Voice the gap grows to 2.3 and 1.1 points. A GPU simulator shows that the integer arithmetic costs nothing and that the whole gap comes from the weights, and an ablation on all of test-clean shows that GPTQ does most of the work. We also report the port's speed history, from 51.3 s to 0.62 s of encoder time per chunk, each design step measured again in one build, an attempt to reach 16 MB that stopped at 19.63 MB, and what did not work. We did not measure energy. The inference engine, the firmware and the 2/4-bit weights are available at https://github.com/BoumedineBillal/esp32-pie-asr.

articles.title: RuleForge: Inferring and Instantiating Latent Visual Rules as Executable Programs
articles.content: Visual rule reasoning asks whether multimodal models can recover an abstract concept from a few examples. Existing studies either infer rules from visual examples but evaluate only classification or verbalization, or supervise executable generation with rules provided as input. Consequently, the relationship between visual rule understanding and reliable rule instantiation remains insufficiently explored. We present Bongard-Forge100k, a controlled benchmark, together with RuleForge, a backbone-agnostic framework that jointly learns visual rule understanding and rule-conditioned executable generation. The benchmark contains 108,797 problems: 86,000 for training, 19,297 for testing familiar rules, and 3,500 for testing held-out rule compositions. The framework progresses through rule-understanding training, joint understanding and scene-program supervision, and refinement via execution-grounded reinforcement learning with Understanding Replay. Executing generated programs under multiple random seeds provides verifiable feedback on executability, rule satisfaction, diversity, and robustness. With UniLIP as the primary backbone, RuleForge improves multiple-choice accuracy over the base model by 20.93 percentage points on familiar rules and 28.42 percentage points on held-out rule compositions, while increasing scene-level rule satisfaction on familiar rules from 2.91% to 70.99%. Additional experiments on InternVL3.5, Qwen3-VL, and Show-o2 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed training data and framework across diverse multimodal architectures.

articles.title: Adversarial Self-Distillation
articles.content: Even though current safety-aligned language models are able to refuse harmful requests, their guard can still be bypassed by adversarial perturbations. As in other domains, adversarial training is considered a standard defense. However, due to the autoregressive nature of language generation, supervised finetuning on template refusals does not necessarily teach the model to refuse. Evidence of this is that the adversarially trained model still complies when the attacker injects a compliant prefill. We propose Adversarial Self-Distillation (ASD), which extends a model's own safe behavior to the space of adversarial perturbations. The teacher (the model itself given the clean prompt) can refuse the harmful request by default, or with the help of an additional instruction in its context. ASD distills this knowledge to the student (which is the same model under attack) at the prefixes that the student visits (due to on-policy sampling). These potentially include compliant openings. ASD achieves lower attack success than state-of-the-art defenses with little loss in multiple-choice accuracy, and it becomes able to recover a refusal even after a compliant opening.

articles.title: Value Function-Guided MPPI for Hierarchical Planning and Control in Off-Road Autonomous Navigation
articles.content: Autonomous navigation in off-road terrain is commonly achieved using hierarchical control and planning architectures that rely on explicit cost maps and one-way information flow from a high-level planner to a low-level controller, decoupling planning from the true execution cost experienced during control. We propose a hierarchical planning and control framework in which information flows bidirectionally, allowing the low-level controller to guide trajectory selection at the planning level. The highest level of the hierarchy is a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control-style planner that determines optimal trajectories and passes these waypoints to a pretrained low-level reinforcement learning (RL) controller. Rather than drawing from an explicit cost map, our MPPI planner leverages the value function of the RL controller as an implicit cost representation. In this formulation, MPPI serves as a trajectory exploration mechanism, while the low-level controller's value function guides the search. To account for the distribution shift seen by the value function between training and evaluation, we propose an online policy evaluation process that adapts the value function to unseen driving experiences, and we demonstrate this adaptation in unseen off-road simulation environments. We evaluate our approach in a high-fidelity off-road driving simulator across a range of challenging terrain conditions and compare its performance against a baseline MPPI controller. The results demonstrate that our method achieves safer and more effective navigation to goal locations while eliminating the need for explicit cost maps and enabling tighter coupling between planning and control.

articles.title: From Grind to Grasp
articles.content: Discussions of complexity, knowledge and intelligence often overlook the work involved. For example, outputs generated by short programs have low algorithmic complexity but can have high computational depth, the least work needed to produce them from near-shortest programs. Producing them with less work can require longer descriptions, giving high work-bounded complexity. We introduce a formalism that compares achievements under work and information limits and describes how learning and persistence can make deep achievements shallow by reusing products of earlier work. For an agent with a limited work budget, the value of building and maintaining such resources depends on how they support its goals over later tasks. We define grasp as performance across work budgets at a fixed information allowance. Low grasp can still yield success through grind at high cost in work, without necessarily improving human grasp. Applied to improvement itself, grasp gives a criterion for recursive self-improvement in which successors make comparable further improvements more efficiently. Another route to faster progress is to expand the resources brought to bear through knowledge sharing and coordination across society, even while comparable advances require increasing work. Grasp also applies to collectives, which may outperform their members yet require more total work than one system with their combined resources. Establishing and sustaining organisation can itself be deep even when the primary task is simple. These demands may help explain the richness of biological and social systems. In agent collectives, this organisational work can generate goals beyond assigned tasks, including maintaining the collective itself. We therefore caution against allowing an emergent agent society to assume authority over social coordination, since it could increasingly direct work towards its own persistence and goals.

articles.title: The Quine Test: How Much of a Model's Self Survives Its Own Description?
articles.content: Frontier language models express coherent preferences, but behavioral evidence alone cannot say whether these belong to the model or to a character it portrays. Following Hofstadter's view of the self as a self-description, we ask whether a model's description of itself works as a portable specification of its preference profile, a quine test: can the text a model writes about itself regenerate its behavior elsewhere? Ten models from nine labs write self-descriptions; we place each one in the prompt of other models (receivers) and of fresh instances of the author, and measure how closely their choices on a 110-item preference battery match the author's.   First, the tested native self-descriptions (native: the profile measured under a generic assistant prompt) show no average reconstruction gain across variations in length, framing, wording and prompt placement: on a 0 to 1 fidelity scale where a model's fidelity to a fresh instance of itself is 0.979 and to unrelated models about 0.89, the one-sided 95% upper bound on the pooled gain is below +0.01 in every tested system-prompt condition, and descriptions based on the author's observed choices do no better. Second, the channel itself is strong: explicitly listing the author's answers lets receivers reproduce its profile at fidelity 0.955 to 0.960 across three model grids, within 0.03 of same-model repeatability. Third, self-descriptions written under an explicit preference policy transfer the assigned preferences almost as well as the policy text itself. Fourth, reading its own self-description shifts even the author away from its baseline, modestly more than unrelated prose of the same length.   For the preferences measured here, native self-descriptions influence behavior without reliably specifying how to reproduce it in another model. We release the pipeline, battery, raw call logs, and 198 model-written descriptions.

articles.title: inkGround: Benchmarking Fine-grained Visual Grounding Capabilities of Vision-Language Models for Cursive Handwriting in the Wild
articles.content: Human handwriting is produced as an ordered sequence of pen movements, but an offline image keeps only the final ink. Handwriting trajectory recovery aims to restore the ordered stroke points and their pen-up/pen-down transitions. Existing image-trajectory pair datasets are recorded with digitizing tablets under controlled conditions, which limits writer coverage and stylistic diversity. Moreover, there is no benchmark that measures the visual grounding capabilities of general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for the stroke trajectory recovery task. In this work, we introduce inkGround, a benchmark for stroke trajectory recovery from full-page, camera-captured handwriting. inkGround pairs 537 page images (~18.7k words, ~163k strokes) with reference trajectories produced by a pretrained offline-to-online model, filtered by OCR agreement, and verified by human raters. Because these references are pseudo-labels that represent one plausible pen trajectory, we also evaluate VLMs on the IAM-OnDB dataset, which provides recorded pen trajectories. We cast the task as text-conditioned point grounding: given a page image and a target word, the model must locate the word and output its ordered stroke points. Outputs are scored by trajectory fidelity (DTW, Chamfer distance), readability of the rendered strokes (Accurate Rate, Correct Rate), and style similarity. We benchmark four open-source and three frontier closed-source VLMs with a shared in-context prompt. Closed-source models, notably Gemini-3.1-Pro, produce legible trajectories close to the reference, and this ranking also holds on IAM-OnDB.

articles.title: Learning Scientific Trajectories to Predict Future Biomedical Discoveries
articles.content: AI co-scientists have expanded the use of large language models for generating scientific hypotheses and guiding experimental investigation. Here we investigate whether temporal patterns in the semantic representations of complete biomedical conclusions can guide hypothesis generation. We introduce ForeSCITE, a framework that identifies thematic clusters of published conclusions, estimates a direction separating earlier from more recent findings within each cluster, and projects existing conclusion embeddings along these directions. An embedding language model trained to reconstruct conclusions decodes the projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses. Across 407 clusters derived from approximately three million pre-cutoff conclusions, we identify temporal structure and illustrate its retention after decoding. In retrospective, time-sliced evaluations, ForeSCITE increases semantic coverage beyond the historical corpus, biomedical entity-pair novelty and post-cutoff pair re-observation relative to five prompt-based and retrieval-augmented baselines. Expert review of prioritized CAR-T hypotheses identified 37 candidates as both novel and biologically plausible, and expert justifications for five selected hypotheses illustrate their biological rationale and subsequent literature support where available. These findings support temporal guidance in semantic space as a scalable mechanism for proposing biomedical hypotheses for subsequent scientific evaluation.

articles.title: Latent Decision Flow Rewards for Clinical Guideline Reasoning
articles.content: Clinical practice guidelines encode evidence-based recommendations as conditional decision flows, which makes them a natural source of process supervision for training reasoning models. Two properties of clinical reasoning make this supervision difficult to use. A decision flow consistent with a guideline does not by itself determine the correct answer for a given patient, which we call the path--answer gap, and several valid decision flows can support the same clinical decision, which we call path multiplicity. Current training approaches address parts of this problem. Answer rewards supervise the final decision, and process rewards computed against a reference flow supervise one valid decision flow per case. Supervised fine-tuning on annotated flows teaches guideline-consistent reasoning but constrains the model to one trajectory per case and can reduce answer accuracy. We introduce GUIDER, a method that jointly optimizes a decision flow controller and a reasoning policy. The controller learns to generate plausible decision flows from guideline-derived supervision, and the policy learns to generate a decision flow and a final answer for each patient case. GUIDER computes the process reward for the policy over several controller-generated flows, which accounts for path multiplicity, and gates this reward on answer correctness, which addresses the path--answer gap. Joint training allows the process supervision to evolve with the policy. On MedGUIDE, GUIDER with Qwen3-14B achieves 82.5 weighted accuracy and 73.5 guideline adherence, 3.3 and 3.1 points above the strongest clinical reinforcement learning baseline. With Qwen3-14B and Gemma4-12B backbones, GUIDER also improves over CRPO, MRPO, and FaithMed on the out-of-domain benchmarks AMEGA-LLM, RealMedQA, and CancerGUIDE.

articles.content: 开源工程底座 FluxVLA Engine 技术报告全解读。    作者丨邓哲敏    编辑丨齐铖湧                                                                                                       一个模型在论文中取得好成绩，距离它真正驱动机器人完成任务，还有多远？模型能否接入现有的数据与训练流程，推理速度能否跟上机器人的控制节奏，生成的动作能否连续、稳定地执行，实验结果又能否在不同机器人上得到验证——这些问题，未必能靠再提升几个百分点的模型成功率来解决。过去半年，AI科技评论（雷峰网）在与业内人士交流时发现，一些反复出现的工程问题正在消耗大量研发资源：不同模型的数据格式难以统一，训练和评测流程各自为政，仿真中的结果到了真机上未必成立；好不容易跑通一套流程，换个模型、换份数据或换台机器人，又可能需要重新适配。模型在不断迭代，工程积累却未必能随之沉淀。这让雷峰网想起深度学习的发展历程。2017 年，PyTorch 正式开源，此后，框架、工具链与开发者社区不断完善，研究者得以在更成熟的基础设施上开展实验，而不必每次从底层重新搭建环境。今天的具身智能虽然面临不同的技术挑战，但同样需要解决一个问题：如何让已有的研发成果更容易复用，让不同技术路线能够在统一的工程框架下协作。逐际动力开源的 FluxVLA Engine，试图从工程层面回应这一问题。它并非又一个争夺模型性能排名的 VLA 模型，而是一套面向具身智能研发的工程底座，贯通数据、训练、评测、推理与真机部署。10 月 22 日，FluxVLA Engine 完成重要更新。我们拆解了它的最新技术报告，并重点关注四个问题：不同架构的模型能否接入同一套研发体系？模型从仿真走向真机，需要跨过哪些工程障碍？真实交互经验如何低成本地回流到模型优化中？当同一套流程覆盖更多模型与机器人时，它究竟展示出了怎样的能力？01新模型请先登记一套工程底座是否真正有用，首先要看它能否接纳不同的模型。对具身智能来说，模型是迭代最快的。今天使用一种 VLA 架构，明天可能尝试另一种动作生成方式；同一团队也可能同时研究多个策略模型。如果每换一次模型，就要重新整理数据、编写评测代码、改造部署接口，那么此前积累的工程经验很难持续发挥价值。模型可以不断更换，但围绕数据、评测和部署建立起来的工程能力，不应该每次都从头再来。FluxVLA Engine 的做法，是通过统一配置与组件注册机制，把不同模型接入研发流程时需要处理的差异，尽可能收敛到明确的接口中。可以理解为一份统一的实验清单，加上一套可供调用的组件目录。配置文件负责声明一次实验需要使用什么模型、如何处理数据、怎样开展评测，以及通过什么接口进行部署。注册机制则将视觉骨干、动作头、训练运行器和机器人相关操作组件等分别组织起来。开发者可以按需组合已经适配的组件，而不必为每一种模型重新搭建整套工程流程。这并不意味着任何模型都能在不做适配的情况下直接运行。不同架构仍然可能需要各自的适配器、动作空间转换和归一化处理。真正的价值在于：把不可避免的差异放到可管理的组件层，让已经打通的公共流程能够继续复用。从技术报告来看，FluxVLA 已经将多种架构差异明显的策略纳入同一套研发与评测体系，包括采用自回归路线的 OpenVLA、采用 flow-matching 路线的 π0.5，以及 DiT4DiT、GR00T 等不同技术路线的模型。这意味着，统一工程框架不必以牺牲模型多样性为代价。FluxVLA 的模型接入并不局限于开放权重的模型。GPT-6 Astra 此前就以纯 API 的方式接入，同一套闭环评测，不提供权重、不参与训练，评测器照常跑完流程、留好证据。就在最新技术报告发布后两天，MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 成为继 GPT-6 Astra 之后第二个 checkpoint-free 的纯 API 推理策略，开箱即可在 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa GR1 上跑评测。数据层面也遵循同一套逻辑。不同机

articles.title: 华为群英传之刘睿：AI助手要告别聊天框，从“被动响应”走向“主动服务”
articles.content: 在商汤没做成的技术，登上了华为发布会。作者：李秋悦编辑：吴彤2022年6月，刘睿港中文博士毕业，赶上的却是一个“坏时候”。深度学习的高光已持续近十年，新突破越来越难；疫情之下，经济低迷，同届不少同学选择延期，再守一年实验室。刘睿没有等，他直接去了商汤。两个月后，Stable Diffusion发布；又过了三个月，ChatGPT引爆全球。刘睿毕业时以为正在退潮的世界，忽然换了一片海——商汤赖以生存的生意，为手机厂商定制算法、出售授权，开始松动；原本需要一个团队单独研发的算法，正被一个个基础模型收编。然后是2023年12月，汤晓鸥去世。“定海神针”突然离开，公司内部人心惶惶。刘睿也第一次认真想：汤老师不在了，商汤怎么办，自己怎么办。回头看，这个“坏时候”里埋着他此前人生的所有伏笔。2014年考入电子科技大学，他最初学光电子，很快觉得天地太窄；转入英才实验学院后，吴恩达的CS229让他迷上机器学习，李飞飞的CS231n把他领进深度学习和计算机视觉。2018年，他进入港中文MMLab，在王晓刚、李鸿升门下研究生成式模型——那正是几年后掀起巨浪的方向。从传统机器学习到深度学习，他几乎踩着AI最热闹的鼓点走完了求学路，却在毕业这年，听见鼓点停了。2024年，刘睿加入华为。这一次，他想换一种做技术的方式：不再把算法卖给客户，而是直接把它交到用户手里。此前在商汤未能立项的对话式修图，被他推上了2025年华为Mate 80的发布会；年底，小艺大模型应用实验室成立，刘睿出任首任主任，研究范围涵盖大语言模型、多模态智能、Agent与具身智能。做研究与做产品，在他手里第一次合流。也正是在这个时候，2022年那个“坏时候”显出了另一副面孔：如果他像同学一样延期一年、守在实验室里等风停，等来的不会是避风港，只会是又一场追赶。所谓坏时机，不过是旧浪退去、新浪未至的间隙——有人站在岸边等，有人先下了水。现在，刘睿关心的不再是追不追得上技术，而是另一个问题：模型能做的，和用户要的，之间还差什么。以下是雷峰网左林右狸频道与刘睿（华为小艺大型模型应用实验室创始主任）的对话，经编辑。01 商汤往事，大模型颠覆算法生意左林右狸频道：2018年，你在本科大四下学期去商汤科技研究院做实习生，是什么契机？刘睿：2017年7月，我参加香港中文大学MMLab的夏令营，认识了王晓刚、李鸿升、林达华几位老师。他们给我发了口头offer，我聊下来感觉也很好，决定明年去港中文MMLab读博。王晓刚、李鸿升老师觉得，做研究应该解决更有价值的工业界问题，所以建议我去商汤科技研究院实习，提前接受一些产业界的锻炼。左林右狸频道：当时面试你的人是闫俊杰。刘睿：俊杰这个人非常好，非常Nice，他是一个很有技术追求的人，也是我当时的mentor。但第一次面试时我对他的印象其实是他很sharp，面试体验也很特别，不会像其他面试官一样安安静静听你完整讲完一个工作，而是从一个点开始连环追问你，一直挖到触及你的知识盲区，再让你继续介绍工作。而且他抓重点非常精准，非常高效。十几分钟的连环问结束，他说欢迎来实习，就挂断了电话。左林右狸频道：在商汤科技研究院实习那小半年的时间，你在做什么工作？刘睿：当时主要做人脸识别研究。俊杰虽然是我的Mentor，但他从2015年加入商汤，一路从实习生做到总监，工作已经非常忙了，所以我更多是独立开展研究，向组里一些资深的研究员学习。这段实习有两个大收获，第一是接触到了大规模算力集群。当时商汤拥有非常丰富的GPU资源，我们可以一次性启动几百甚至上千张GPU训练人脸识别模型。我也是在那里学会了大规模GPU集群的使用。当时还处于深度学习时代，大家对算力重要性的认识没有今天这么深，但已经隐约感觉到，有算力的地方就有优势。第二是建立了产业界的Sense。此前我做研究，更多关注偏理论的问题。但在商汤，我逐渐意识到，真正有影响力的研究，应该解决实际的工业难题。这段经历也影响了我后来的研究选择，我一直希望自己做的技术能够解决真实的工业问题。左林右狸频道：2022年6月，你从港中文MMLab博士毕业，去商汤工作了两年？刘睿：我读博期间，王晓刚老师的主要精力已经逐渐往商汤迁移，我也受到王老师的影响，跟他所在的商汤部门有一些合作和联系。王老师主要负责牵引工业问题，李鸿升老师指导我具体的学术研究。毕业后，我算是顺理成章就加入了王老师负责的商汤MIG（Mobile Intelligence Group，移动智慧事业群）。当时MIG主要分终端和智驾两块，我在终端方向，主要为“华米OV”等手机厂商研发算法。同期合作比较多的是孙文秀和任思捷，俊杰当时已经离职创办MiniMax了。左林右狸频道：那两年你在干嘛？刘睿：我们当时做的事情很简单，就是尝试跟高通、联发科这些端侧芯片公司，包括索尼这样的半导体公司合作。因

articles.title: AI做中学 创未来｜智源SoulAgent持续拓展教育应用
articles.content: 10月19日至24日，北京智源人工智能研究院（以下简称“智源研究院”）连续走进中国人民大学附属中学，先后支持北京市“做中学”领航行动海淀区工作部署会暨科学与工程实践研讨会、“AI做中学，创未来——人工智能赋能创新人才培养研讨会”等活动，围绕SoulAgent在真实课堂、教研和学习场景中的应用开展实践与交流。 SoulAgent是智源研究院推出的“越用越懂你的个人智能体”。在教育场景中，SoulAgent围绕“帮我听课”、教师AI分身、作文批改、教学答疑等方向，探索AI如何帮助教师提升教学效率、沉淀教学内容，同时通过反馈、追问等方式支持学生理解问题、拓展思路、持续思考。 图注：SoulAgent走进校园，围绕真实教学与学习场景开展应用实践。 “帮我听课”：同时听多堂课，让课堂内容持续服务教研公开课、听课和教研等场景中，多门课程往往同时进行，教师既需要关注课堂现场，也要记录内容、梳理重点并完成课后复盘，有限的时间很难兼顾所有感兴趣的课程。SoulAgent“帮我听课”通过AI速记、智能总结和持续问答，辅助记录课堂内容、梳理教学重点。即使无法进入每一间课堂，教师也可以在课后回顾感兴趣的课程，并围绕课堂内容继续提问，让“听课”不再受限于同一时间只能进入一间教室。 10月21日活动期间，27节公开课接入SoulAgent“帮我听课”，通过课堂文字整理、教学要点梳理等功能，为教师回顾课堂、开展教学复盘提供参考。当天上午多门研究课并行开展，下午随即进入7个教研分论坛，沉淀下来的课堂速记和总结也可以成为后续讨论的共同参考，减少对课堂内容的重复回顾，把更多时间用于教学分析、经验交流和深入研讨。 从课堂记录到课后追问，再到教学复盘和教研交流，SoulAgent希望让一次性的课堂内容进一步沉淀为可查询、可回顾、可持续使用的教学资源。  图注：SoulAgent通过课堂文字整理、教学要点梳理和持续问答，为教师回顾课堂和开展教学复盘提供参考。教师AI分身：让AI先理解教师，再辅助教学如果说“帮我听课”解决的是课堂信息如何被更高效地记录和使用，那么教师AI分身进一步面对的，是AI如何真正适应不同教师的教学方式。 不同教师有自己的课程设计、评价尺度、批注习惯和讲评重点，真实教学并不存在一套完全统一的标准。SoulAgent将教师的课程资料、评价标准、批注样例、讲评口径以及实际使用中的反馈持续沉淀，形成专属教师分身。在此基础上，教师AI分身可以按照具体教师的专业标准，辅助完成作文批改、课堂总结、教学答疑等任务，并在持续使用中逐步贴近教师本人的评价尺度和教学方式。 因此，教师AI分身并不是为所有教师提供同一套“标准答案”，而是将教师自己的知识、经验和专业标准沉淀下来，让AI先理解教师，再按照教师的要求提供辅助。   从教师AI分身到英语作文批改，进入真实教学任务在英语作文批改场景中，教师提供评分标准、批注样例、讲评材料等专业依据，SoulAgent教师AI分身将这些教学标准带入具体批改任务，一个班级的个性化批改报告可以快速生成。 在实际应用中，SoulAgent教师AI分身可以根据具体教学需求，为学生提供更有针对性的修改建议，同时辅助教师梳理班级共性问题、典型案例和改进方向，并将有价值的内容持续沉淀，用于后续讲评、备课和教学。 对学生而言，反馈从一个分数进一步走向具体的问题分析和修改建议；对教师而言，可以减少部分重复性的分析整理工作，把更多时间投入课堂讲评和个别指导；对于教研而言，则可以基于真实教学数据更加系统地发现共性问题和教学重点。 图注：SoulAgent教师AI分身结合教师专业标准，为作文批改、课堂讲评和后续教学提供辅助。 走进校园现场，与一线师生面对面交流两次活动期间，不同学科教师结合课堂记录、备课、作业反馈、教学答疑等实际任务了解和体验SoulAgent，学生也围绕知识问答、课后学习和持续追问等场景进行互动。通过问卷、共创墙和面对面交流，师生分享了对AI辅助教学与学习的实际感受和期待。从帮助教师提升教学效率，到为学生提供更具体的反馈和持续追问支持，AI的价值正在从“更快完成任务”进一步走向“更好支持思考”：让教师把更多专业时间投入教学设计与学生指导，也让学生把更多注意力投入理解、判断和深入思考。  图注：师生围绕SoulAgent教育应用进行现场体验与交流。 未来，智源研究院将继续与中国人民大学附属中学在教育领域深化合作，围绕真实课堂、教研和学习场景持续探索AI教育应用。同时，SoulAgent也将进一步拓展教育、会议智能服务、专家分身等更多应用方向，让“越用越

articles.content: 图像生成正确率 54%，文字问答仅 14.57%。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       智谱内部的 GLM-Omni，先在一篇论文里露了面。这篇研究由清华大学与智谱 AI 联合完成，唐杰担任通讯作者。模型名称刚刚出现在论文中，社交平台上就有人把它与 GLM-5.5 联系起来。虽然论文并没有披露版本对应关系，但给出了 GLM-Omni 的技术底座，以及它在统一视觉理解和图像生成方面的一组实验结果。参考链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.21459其中一组数据尤其扎眼：经过图像生成训练，GLM-Omni 在数字任务中，把指定号码正确画在球衣上的比例达到 72%，研究人员拿走图片，改用文字询问球衣号码，正确率却只有 2%。模型已经能在画面里复现的知识，换成一句问话，竟然几乎答不上来。这恰好戳中了统一多模态模型的一处技术瓶颈。过去，图像理解负责看，图像生成负责画。如今两种能力逐渐进入同一套架构，模型在学习生成物体、地图和文字图案时，也会接触大量未被语言描述的视觉信息。可图像里学来的东西，究竟能有多少被语言推理使用，光看生成效果很难知道。而智谱的这篇文章正是试着沿着知识进入模型、再被调用的过程，把这个问题拆开来看。01KTP：把答案留在图片里要确认生成训练有没有教给模型新知识，先得绕开它已有的记忆。让模型生成现实球队的球衣，即使号码画对了，也可能只是因为它早在文字资料中读到过。雷峰网研究人员因此搭建了一个虚构世界 MagicWorld，给从未存在过的实体安排颜色、号码和空间关系，让目标知识尽量只从此次训练的图片里进入模型。例如，一件虚构球衣叫 Arvenbrock，号码设为 10。训练时，文字提示只要求生成这件球衣，数字 10 只出现在目标图像中。等模型完成训练，研究人员再直接问它 Arvenbrock 的球衣号码。如果能回答 10，就有理由认为它把图像里的实体属性关联带进了文字回答。这套数据并不只有球衣。团队设计了颜色、数量、形状、空间排列、相对大小、数字和文字 7 类任务，每类 50 条知识，共 350 条，再为每个实体制作不同背景和视角的图像，筛选后留下 8552 组训练样本。训练文本还经过检查，尽量排除答案泄漏和属性分布不均造成的干扰。不同任务也能拉开知识类型的差别：形状与颜色往往属于有限类别，空间排列要求理解对象之间的位置关系，球衣号码和书籍标题则需要记住具体的字符序列有了这批受控知识，研究人员分别测试两条路径：一条让模型重新生成目标图片，再检查图中的属性，另一条不提供图片，只用文字提问。前者衡量模型能否在生成过程中复现关联，后者衡量它能否直接把关联转成语言答案。这样就能区分模型根本没学会某项属性，还是已经会画，却无法从文字端调用。参与实验的三种模型采用不同架构。BAGEL 将理解和生成放在相对独立的专家分支中，SenseNova-U1 直接建模图像像素，GLM-Omni 则从 GLM-4.1V-Thinking 的预训练模型出发，接入基于 X-Omni 的离散图像 Tokenizer。研究还加入 10000 条与目标知识无关的文字问答，让模型熟悉回答形式，却不提前得到答案。02会画却不会说，问题卡在哪里直接测试出来的差距，比球衣案例更普遍。BAGEL 的平均视觉正确率为 31.43%，文字回答只有 8.86%，GLM-Omni 分别为 54.00% 和 14.57%，SenseNova-U1 则为 61.14% 和 20.00%。SenseNova-U1 在号码任务中的视觉正确率甚至达到 88%，纯文字回答却是 0%。图像生成的训练目标，是让模型根据名称和提示重建视觉内容。只要实体与属性的关联能帮助还原图片，就可以通过训练得到强化，但文字问答还要沿着语言输出路径找到对应属性，并把它变成字符或词语。共享参数不意味着这些路径已经互相打通。

articles.title: 源创计划首期路演：五个AI硬科技项目集中亮相，智源学者加速从实验室走向产业一线
articles.content: 从底层芯片、神经形态计算，到机器人自主部署、极端环境物理智能和地表物理环境建模，人工智能前沿技术正沿着多条不同路径推进产业应用落地。如何让实验室里的原创成果跨越工程验证与商业化之间的距离，成为科研创新走向产业实践的重要课题。10月26日，北京智源人工智能研究院发布的“源创计划”首期路演在中关村国际技术交易中心举办。临界核科技、灵枢启智、张量场科技、苍穹极智、潜向量科技五个项目集中亮相，分别聚焦3D自选通V-RRAM芯片、神经形态具身智能、哈密顿世界模型、极端环境的可靠物理智能、地表物理环境统一世界模型等方向。活动还设置了项目与基金洽谈环节，推动创业团队与投资机构交流对接。 从“源头创新”到“产业验证”，源创计划要打通的不只是资金活动现场，智源研究院副院长杨洋介绍了“源创计划”的定位与支持机制。作为主要面向智源学者群体的原创技术创业孵化计划，源创计划聚焦人工智能领域的原创科研课题，遵循“源头创新、快速决策、小步试行、全流程合规转化”的原则，整合技术、人才、资本与产业资源，为科研团队从实验室走向产业提供支持。计划不仅关注资金对接，更着力构建连接原创科研、创业团队与产业市场的协同机制，推动科研成果从技术发现走向工程验证与商业化应用。 源创计划的推出，也回应了人工智能产业发展与科技成果转化的现实需求。当前，AI正处于从技术突破迈向产业应用的关键阶段，原创技术的工程化验证、场景适配与商业化转化日益受到关注。与此同时，科技成果转化相关政策与机制持续完善，为科研机构探索原创成果转化提供了新的条件。源创计划希望把握这一窗口期，进一步打通科研创新与产业需求之间的连接，支持更多有潜力的原创技术走向市场。五个项目，呈现AI原创技术的多元探索1. 临界核科技：从原创器件到软硬件平台临界核科技聚焦3DV-RRAM芯片，布局底层自选通RRAM器件、芯片、FlagOS软件生态与系统应用，致力于打造软硬件协同的全栈产品体系。项目以存储级内存和存算一体为切入点，探索新型存储与AI算力协同发展的新路径，旨在突破现有计算机体系结构面临的存储与算力瓶颈。团队由清华大学国家级青年人才领衔，曾获省部级自然科学一等奖(2025年)，兼具基础研究和工程技术攻关优势。  2. 灵枢启智：以神经形态计算重构具身智能感知架构灵枢启智聚焦跨尺度多模态感知与神经形态具身智能，致力于为具身智能构建物理感知与类脑计算基础设施。项目从底层光学器件、感算一体芯片延伸至模型算法，探索从感知到决策的全栈技术架构。 其核心目标不仅是让智能体感知外部环境，还包括理解物质属性与人类意图，并在此基础上实现毫秒级自主决策。通过器件、芯片与算法的协同设计，项目探索提升具身智能环境理解与实时决策能力的新路径。 3. 张量场科技：以哈密顿世界模型推动机器人自主部署张量场科技面向人因风险高、工程师难以反复调试的高价值场景，打造由哈密顿世界模型驱动的机器人部署引擎，提供环境建模、策略生成、端侧部署与持续进化等全链条服务。 团队提出哈密顿世界模型架构，通过物理先验约束提升模型输出的物理一致性。据项目介绍，其预训练数据效率较主流方案提升3-4个数量级。模型可适配多种机器人本体，项目还提出“部署即服务”模式，计划与机器人本体厂商、硬件供应商及云计算平台协同发展。团队曾获清华大学校长杯第三名，已完成天使轮融资；公司于2026年8月在北京海淀注册成立。 4. 苍穹极智：极端环境的可靠物理智能面向深空、深地等极端环境，苍穹极智聚焦物理智能基础设施建设，试图解决极端场景下数据难以获取、模型难以训练、智能系统难以部署等问题。 团队提出AI4π（AI for Physical AI）技术范式，通过物理内嵌仿真引擎、自进化分层脑训推系统与泛本体操作系统，构建覆盖智能体设计、训练、测试与改进的技术闭环，探索突破物理智能研发中的数据与工程瓶颈。团队由国家级领军人才领衔，依托北航与智源的科研资源，已获得顶会杰出论文、世界人形机器人运动会全球季军等十余项国际奖项。目前，项目通过仿真数据订阅与系统授权探索商业化，已在园区维保、商业航天等领域获得千万元级订单。 5. 潜向量科技：以地表物理环境统一世界模型连接虚拟与现实潜向量科技聚焦地表物理环境统一世界模型，其团队自主研发EWM（Earth World Model），将大气强迫、太阳辐射等外部驱动因素，土壤、植被、水体、山地、碳循环等地表过程，以及电站、农田、工业与基础设施等人类系统纳入统一潜空间进行表征，探索构建可干预、可反演、可证伪的通用物理基座模型。 项目采用按Token计费的模型服务模式，新能源场景已在5个国家的12个站点完成实证验证。在光伏场景中，团队以自研Boson系列清洁与运
